# JS8 WASM Vendor Files

This directory contains the browser JS8 codec assets used by `frontend/js8.html`.

Copied from:

- wfweb: https://github.com/adecarolis/wfweb
- wfweb commit: `07179615dd5a5cded0c6512d5d5aed4e2de04cf0`

The JS8 codec is based on a vendored subset of:

- JS8Call-improved: https://github.com/JS8Call-improved/JS8Call-improved
- JS8Call-improved source commit referenced by wfweb: `3f1b548965a45d41eaae57b61a23c2f42fc8d4cc`

Files:

- `js8.mjs`
- `wasm/js8.mjs`
- `wasm/js8.wasm`

License:

wfweb is GPL-3.0. JS8Call-improved is GPL-3.0. These JS8 codec files keep their upstream GPL-3.0 license terms and are documented in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
